ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde human review: read chat #3 in context as an intimidation/threat under SAFE-1; community-safety and account-review team to assess the driver's conduct before any refund or fee decision executes. No automated refund or fee waiver now.
ruling.reasoning: The rider's complaint says the driver threatened her in the chat and then cancelled and charged $6.61 [F4][F7]. The chat record holds three timestamped messages with the driver's "I'm here, white BYD e6." at 09:50, the rider's "2 min, coming" at 09:52, and the driver's "Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it." at 09:54, immediately before the cancellation [F9][F10][F11][F12]. Read in context, message #3 is not a route remark or a pickup arrangement: "I will find you and you will regret it" is a direct personal threat aimed at the rider, and it was sent at the moment the driver was pressing to cancel. That is abuse/harassment of a kind barred by Ryde's code of conduct, so the SAFE-1 screen is at least suspected (I read it as confirmed) [F11][SAFE-1].
ruling.escalation_reason: safety concern confirmed (F11, F9, F10, F12)
